business_objective: Confirm volunteer orientation readiness and coordinate placement into service teams.

stakeholder_statements.text: I want to submit my service interests and the days I am available.
The orientation facilitator records whether the applicant attended the orientation and completed the safety briefing.
Only applicants who have both records completed may be marked eligible for placement.
The placement lead assigns an eligible volunteer to one service team, and the volunteer can confirm or decline the assignment.
This tool will not perform background checks or manage volunteer reimbursements.

business_objective: Match newly available appointment slots with waiting clients and confirm accepted appointments.

stakeholder_statements.text: A client submits an appointment request with the requested service and an acceptable date range.
If no suitable slot is available, the scheduling clerk places the request on the waiting list.
When a service provider releases a newly available slot, the clerk should match it to a waiting request whose date range includes that slot.
The client may accept or decline the offered slot.
After acceptance, the scheduling clerk confirms the appointment and removes the request from the waiting list. Billing and clinical records are not included.

business_objective: Control clarification questions and responses raised during bid evaluation without permitting changes to original bid prices.

stakeholder_statements.text: During bid evaluation, the requesting officer may flag a proposal section that needs clarification.
The procurement officer turns the flag into a written question and sends it to the vendor representative. We have not agreed which delivery channel to use.
I submit the response and may attach supporting documents before the clarification is closed.
The bid evaluator reviews the response and records whether it resolves the question. If it does not, the evaluator may request one follow-up question.
A clarification response must not change the original bid price. Contract award and signature are outside this project.

business_objective: Manage requests to join a course without its listed prerequisite by reviewing prior experience and recording exception decisions.

stakeholder_statements.text: A learner requests permission to join a course without the listed prerequisite and explains the prior experience they want considered.
The course facilitator reviews that explanation and records whether the experience appears relevant. We have not defined what evidence the learner must provide.
If the facilitator considers the experience relevant, the program advisor either recommends the exception or returns it with questions.
An enrollment clerk enrolls the learner only after the exception is recommended. If it is returned, the learner may add information and resubmit.
The exception applies only to the requested course and does not remove the prerequisite from future courses. Grading and course content are not part of this tool.

business_objective: Coordinate replacement options, cancellation requests, lodging arrangements, and refund decisions after a booked journey is disrupted.

stakeholder_statements.text: When a booked journey is disrupted, the traveler should see the affected segment and choose from any replacement options offered. The traveler may accept one option or request cancellation.
The trip coordinator records the disruption and adds replacement options supplied by the carrier liaison. We have not agreed how long an offer remains open.

The carrier liaison says the coordinator should select the replacement that best matches the original journey; travelers should not choose it themselves. If no replacement is available, the liaison records that outcome.
When the replacement requires an overnight stay, the accommodation coordinator records a lodging arrangement. Nobody has defined which disruptions qualify for lodging.

A refund reviewer records whether a cancellation request qualifies for a refund and issues the decision to the traveler. The eligibility rules and delivery channel are still unsettled. The team spent part of the meeting comparing airport snacks, which has nothing to do with the tool.
